thread:
Maria: Quick sync — EU canary blackout starts 23:00 UTC. short checklist before we handoff to ops?
Ankit: Can we confirm pins and the emergency rollback thresholds?
Tay: Monitoring dashboards green? Any known flaky tests to disable during the window?
Oliver: I'm proposing we pin model-server image to r3.7 and freeze config pushes for the 2h window.
Riley: Dashboards: infra, traffic, and error budget panels are on. alerting: infra-high-latency, 5xx-rate. I'll raise noise filters for non-prod alerts. :white_check_mark:
Ankit: Rollback policy I'm ok with: auto-rollback if 5xx > 0.5% over 5m OR p95 latency > 800ms for 3 consecutive 1m buckets. Human abort if business errors spike.
Maria: sounds good. Also exempt embeddings-batch jobs (they run long) — we won't pin them; they'll run on dedicated queue.
Oliver: I'll create the pin now. command: ```
# pin canary
deployctl pin --service canary-eu --image r3.7 --reason "blackout window prep" --expires 2h
```
deploy-bot: @Oliver deployctl: pin request accepted. Canaries queued: canary-eu-2026-03-20-23:01 (id: cny-8921). Pin expires at 01:01 UTC.
deploy-bot: CANARY STARTED cny-8921 -> image=r3.7; route=10% shadow=off. Auto-rollback rules: 5xx>0.5% (5m) OR p95>800ms (3x1m). Alerts wired to #oncall-eng and PagerDuty.
Tay: Noted. I'll standby on logs and smoke tests for first 15m. If we see tokenization errors we've seen before, we abort and revert to r3.6.
Maria: handoff: @Riley on monitoring, @Ankit on rollback, @Tay on smoke tests, @Oliver on pins. If no major alerts after 30m we ramp to 30%. :thumbsup:
Ankit: One more: release notes updated and changelog pinned in the ticket. link: https://pm/release/5912 (ops checklist inside).
Riley: Alright dashboards set, synthetic checks added: generation success rate + latency checks. I'll post a short readout at +10m and +30m.
deploy-bot: CANARY UPDATE cny-8921 -> 23:11 UTC: traffic=10% healthy=99.6% p95=312ms 5xx=0.02% :rocket:
Maria: If anything crosses thresholds, call the abort channel immediately. Otherwise we'll proceed with controlled ramp at +45m.
Tay: Smoke tests passing (content sanity + rerank quick checks). No tokenization regressions in first 10m.
Ankit: Setting rollback command ready: ```
deployctl rollback --canary cny-8921 --reason "auto/abort threshold breach"
```
deploy-bot: STATUS cny-8921 -> stable so far. Auto-rollback watch active.
Maria: Good work team. I'll post final green or abort in this thread at +30m. Keep phones close for PD pages. :lock:
